Comparison of VPN Setup Guides:

**Windows VPN (vpn-windows):**
- Client: Built-in Windows VPN client
- Server: vpn.example.com
- Port: 443

**macOS VPN (vpn-macos):**
- Client: Tunnelblick (requires installation)
- Server: vpn.example.com
- Port: 1194

**Key Differences:** Windows uses the OS native built-in client on port 443 (typically HTTPS-friendly), while macOS requires the third-party Tunnelblick client on port 1194 (standard OpenVPN port).

REFUND POLICY
Last Updated: September 6, 2026

1. Overview
We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you are not satisfied, we offer refunds in accordance with the terms outlined below.

2. Eligibility for Refunds
- Refund requests must be made within 30 days of the original purchase date.
- Items must be unused, unwashed, and in their original packaging with all tags attached.
- Proof of purchase (order number, receipt, or confirmation email) is required.

3. Non-Refundable Items
- Gift cards
- Sale or clearance items marked as final sale
- Digital products, downloadable content, and services already rendered
- Personalized or custom-made items

4. How to Request a Refund
To initiate a refund, please contact our support team at support@example.com with your order number and reason for the refund. Once your request is approved, we will provide instructions for returning the item if applicable.

5. Return Shipping
- Customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the return is due to our error (defective, damaged, or incorrect item).
- We recommend using a trackable shipping service as we cannot guarantee receipt of returned items.

6. Refund Processing
- Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
- Approved refunds will be credited to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.
- Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

7. Damaged or Defective Items
If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the damage. We will arrange a replacement or full refund at no additional cost.

8. Late or Missing Refunds
If you have not received your refund within 10 business days after approval, please check with your bank or payment provider, then contact us for assistance.

9. Contact Us
For any questions regarding this refund policy, please contact:
Email: support@example.com
Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567

We reserve the right to update this policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
